api/HandsForMobileAR.CoreComponents.Hand.title: Enum HandTrackingProvider.ModelMode | HandsForMobileAR
api/HandsForMobileAR.CoreComponents.Hand.summary: Enum HandTrackingProvider.ModelMode Namespace HandsForMobileAR.CoreComponents Assembly Assembly-CSharp.dll Mediapipe model options public enum HandTrackingProvider.ModelMode Fields GestureRecognition = 1 This mode uses Gesture Recognition model that is enhanced version of Hand Landmark model. Adds embeding and classification models into computation pipeline. LandmarksOnly = 0 There will be only Hand Landmark model running. So there will be no gesture-related date. You can use this to improve application performance in case you don't need gestures.
